Where the savings came from: the nine causes, a per-client table and fixed-template prompt suggestions for the same ranges as overview

The savings dashboard: hero, per-UTC-day series and nine causes (six monitors, trim, router, memory) for range=7d|30d|custom (custom needs from and to, UTC days, at most 90); saved, likely and would-save are never summed
The biggest saves: acted events with a positive estimate, (estimate desc, id desc); same ranges as overview, page with the opaque cursor and limit (1-100, default 20)

A workspace's sessions, newest first; page with the opaque cursor, bound with from/to (RFC 3339) and limit (1-200); filter by client (the stored family, e.g. opencode or openai-python; unknown means none) and outcome (completed|abandoned|open, else 422)
The proxy URL, ready-made client snippets and the connection status of a workspace
Spend, calls, sessions and the per-day series for range=7d|30d (default 7d)

One trace with its observations, signature and the sessions it helped; 404 when it is not in the workspace
The workspace's trim settings with defaults filled in
